name: network-optimizer-speedtest
description: Network Optimizer Speed Test - Customized OpenSpeedTest component that integrates with Network Optimizer. This is a companion container for Network Optimizer that provides: - Client-side speed testing capabilities - Automatic result reporting to Network Optimizer - Web-based speed test interface Requirements: - Network Optimizer container must be running - HOST_IP or HOST_NAME must be set for result reporting

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for accessing the speed test web interface

variables.name: Host Name
variables.description: Host name for URL construction and host enforcement redirect

variables.name: OpenSpeedTest Port
variables.description: Port number for OpenSpeedTest (should match WebUI Port)

variables.name: OpenSpeedTest HTTPS
variables.description: Set to true if using HTTPS

variables.name: Reverse Proxied Host Name
variables.description: Reverse proxy hostname for result reporting URL
